Alex W: Evening handoff — quick notes before I sign off:
- Canary deploy at ~15:00 PT: variant-canary -> rolled back to variant-v2 after short error spike on /v1/stream for long sequences, impact low, rollback completed.
- Latency: embeddings-prod p50 rose 22ms -> 38ms between ~10:45–11:30 PT; node restart (k8s gpu-07) restored baseline but seeing intermittent 500s for large batch jobs.
- Action items:
  1) Priya to open infra ticket for autoscaler persistent node test tomorrow.
  2) Tom to land PR #4827 (fallback routing config).
  3) Riley to add a small canary smoke for streaming endpoints in CI.
- Watch metrics: embeddings queue length, stream.error_rate, model_retention_coldstart_count.
- Runbook: /runbooks/streaming-errors updated with kv-cache eviction step.
- Oncall ops: no active pager; escalation guideline -> if stream error_rate > 0.5% for >10m escalate to SRE on-call.

Priya S: Got it — opening the ticket now. Do we have logs from gpu-07 to attach?

Alex W: Pasting short log snippet below for context:
```
[2026-03-17T15:02:11Z] model-server: eviction triggered, free_mem 1.2GB
[2026-03-17T15:02:13Z] model-server: stream-handler OOM warning, inflight=18
[2026-03-17T15:02:19Z] kubelet: restarting pod redwood-model-ret-7 due to OOMKilled
```

Tom B: PR #4827 is in review, should turn green in ~45–60m. Left a note to add feature-flag gating. @Riley can you review the smoke test when it's up?

Riley: I will add a minimal smoke tomorrow morning (UTC). Quick Q: current stream latency alert is p95 > 250ms — for long sequences that triggers a lot. Should we raise threshold or add sequence-length gating?

OncallBot: DeployBot: Canary deploy for "model-retention" scheduled at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

Priya S: Log shows repeated OOMs before restart — I'll check node memory and driver metrics, sounds like memory pressure. Creating INF-3245 and attaching these logs.

Alex W: FYI — two customers on higher burst plans were told to expect possible degradation; CS has been notified. Muted the low-priority embeddings-high-latency alert for the next 2h to reduce noise during triage.

Tom B: Note for anyone who needs an immediate rollback: run `REPO=redwood-inference ./scripts/rollback.sh canary-variant`. Also leaving a TODO in the PR to add a stronger fallback routing rule.

Riley: On coverage/shift swaps: I'm swapping Saturday morning with Priya (she's OOO early morning). Priya are you good to cover 06:00–12:00 PT on Sat?

Priya S: Yup, I can take Sat 06:00–12:00 PT. Will follow up on INF-3245 and confirm driver metrics.

Alex W: One more: if cache-miss-rate for model-retention spikes > 15%, temporarily set routing.batch_max=16 as a mitigation (reduces per-request memory pressure). I'll add this to the runbook.

OncallBot: HandoffLog: note saved by Alex W.

Tom B: :thumbsup: I'll keep an eye on the PR and the fallback metric.

Riley: :thumbsup: I'll land the smoke and post CI link in the ticket.

Priya S: INF-3245 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3245

Alex W: :wave: heading offline — ping me if anything crosses the thresholds above.
